description: Generate vector embeddings from text for semantic search and similarity matching.
embedding_description: Generate vector embeddings from text inputs using an OpenAI-compatible API. Provide a list of strings plus optional model and input_type. Returns embeddings array and dimension for semantic search, similarity, clustering, or retrieval indexing.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Vector embeddings with keys: embeddings (list of float arrays), dimension (int), model (string)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Generates vector embeddings from text using OpenAI-compatible API
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ConnectionError: API endpoint not reachable. ValidationError: Invalid input format or empty inputs. APIError: Backend service returned an error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For connection errors: verify the embedding service is running. For validation errors: check input format is a list of strings.
